# Mr GrimeGuru

> Mr GrimeGuru sells 500 ml foam spray cleaners for compatible car surfaces, kitchen surfaces, household surfaces and footwear in India. Product labels and surface care instructions determine suitability and use.

- [Car Cleaner](https://www.mrgrimeguru.com/shop/vehicle-cleaner): Foam-powered care for everyday road dirt on compatible car surfaces. 500 ml, Buy 1 Get 1 Free, ₹799 with MRP ₹899.
- [Kitchen Cleaner](https://www.mrgrimeguru.com/shop/kitchen-cleaner): Kitchen grease and residue on compatible surfaces.
- [Multipurpose Cleaner](https://www.mrgrimeguru.com/shop/multipurpose-cleaner): Everyday cleaning on approved household surfaces.
- [Shoe Cleaner](https://www.mrgrimeguru.com/shop/shoe-cleaner): Cleaning compatible footwear materials.
